name: ERIC (Education Resources Information Center)
description: A U.S. Department of Education-sponsored database of education literature, including thousands of EdTech-related research articles and reports.

name: EDUCAUSE
description: A nonprofit association focused on advancing higher education through the use of information technology, publishing research and hosting conferences.

name: UNESCO Institute for Information Technologies in Education (IITE)
description: UNESCO's dedicated institute researching how ICT can be applied to education policy and practice worldwide.

name: JISC
description: A UK-based organization providing digital research and educational technology guidance to universities and colleges.

name: British Journal of Educational Technology (BJET)
description: A leading peer-reviewed journal covering the design, development, and evaluation of educational technology.

name: Computers & Education
description: An Elsevier-published journal focused on the effective use of computer technology in education across all levels.

name: Educational Technology & Society
description: A quarterly open-access journal publishing research on the pedagogical use of technology to support learning.

name: EdTech Hub
description: A global research partnership focused on generating evidence about educational technology's role in improving learning, especially in low-income countries.

name: OECD Education GPS
description: The OECD's data platform comparing education systems and policies across member countries, including technology adoption trends.

name: Google Scholar
description: A widely used academic search engine indexing scholarly literature across disciplines, including educational technology research.

name: ResearchGate
description: A social networking platform for researchers to share papers, ask questions, and find collaborators, including EdTech-focused work.

name: ASCILITE
description: The Australasian Society for Computers in Learning in Tertiary Education, supporting research and professional practice in learning technology.

name: EdMedia + Innovate Learning Conference
description: An annual international conference on educational multimedia, hypermedia, and telecommunications.

name: SITE (Society for Information Technology & Teacher Education)
description: An international association and annual conference focused on technology in teacher education and professional development.

name: African Journal of Educational Studies in Mathematics and Sciences
description: A peer-reviewed journal publishing STEM and technology-in-education research from and about the African context.

name: SpringerOpen Education Collection
description: A collection of fully open-access Springer journals covering educational research, technology, and pedagogy.
